lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 5 distinct vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is non-uniform, with the widest gap occurring between the second and third visible lines in the mid-torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most line is abbreviated, terminating mid-flank. The posterior-most line on the flank is significantly shorter than the central three, terminating before the dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 4 to 6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch, localized above the stifle joint.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate, spiral trajectory, initiating with a posterior-lateral vector from the pedicle and curving inward toward the medial plane at the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.8 times the combined width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 10-15% of the total longitudinal horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Two prominent white spots are visible on the malar region below the eye; a dark, shaggy ventral fringe extends from the throat along the brisket to the belly.
